tldr: Treatment-noise skewness can identify a confounded causal slope while preserving the entire observed covariance matrix. In the specified Gaussian-source, known-shape mixture benchmark, the focal object is the sharp worst expected length of every randomized connected interval with uniform \(90\) percent coverage. The critical window retains an order-one slope fiber and infinitely many likelihood directions. The paper proves that a certified Gaussian connected-action value transfers uniformly to original records with unknown covariance, including collapsing fibers, and constructs one finite-sample honest interval family attaining the critical limit. Matched length orders and moment identification are supporting checks; the complete critical decision value and its feasible attainment define the subfield contribution.
